title: Role Composer: change-preview timeline + member-impact simulation
creator: Priya Iyer
description: Design a Role Composer experience that lets admins author role changes and immediately preview the real-world impact: 1) a scrubbable change-playback timeline that replays the audit log for a role (who changed what and when), 2) a simulated membership-impact mode that shows which users/groups would gain/lose access across Console surfaces and downstream resources, and 3) safe snapshots + one-click undo for bulk member assignments. The goal is to reduce accidental privilege escalations and make audits and rollbacks fast and discoverable.
goals: Provide a clear, timeline-based visualization of role edits tied to audit logs
Allow admins to simulate membership changes and view affected resources before committing
Enable fast rollback and immutable snapshots for high-impact bulk changes
Surface SSO group mapping implications and warn about external group-driven permission drift
user_stories: As a security admin, I want to scrub through a role's change history so I can understand when a permission was added and by whom
As a product team lead, I want to preview which dashboards and routes will be affected if I add a user to a role
As an on-call engineer, I want an easy 'revert to snapshot' so we can remediate accidental mass-assignments
As an SSO admin, I want warnings when a mapped external group would override local member edits
acceptance_criteria: Timeline playback shows chronological events from audit logs and highlights diffs between states
Simulate mode outputs a list of Console routes, dashboards, and runtime actions impacted by proposed member changes
Snapshots are created automatically before any bulk assign/unassign and can be restored by admins with proper RBAC
SSO-mapped groups are displayed inline with a badge and a clear warning if changes may be overwritten by SAML sync
Design has accessible keyboard controls for timeline scrubbing and ARIA labels for diffs
design_notes: Primary canvas shows role metadata at top, timeline scrubber below (play/pause, speed, jump-to-event), central diff panel (old vs new permissions, member delta), right rail contains simulated impact list and quick rollback snapshot actions. Interaction: toggling 'Simulate membership impact' runs a dry-run service that returns top-20 affected resources with confidence scores. For large orgs, simulation is paginated and shows sampling by default with a 'full scan' warning. Before any bulk member operation, we capture a snapshot and prompt: 'Snapshot created — restore available for 30 days'.
accessibility_considerations: Timeline controls operable via keyboard (space play/pause, arrow scrub +/-),
Diffs have high-contrast highlighting and text alternatives for colorblind users
Simulation results include table rows with accessible descriptions and screen-reader friendly summaries
edge_cases: Concurrent edits: two admins editing same role — UI shows live conflict banner with ability to open a 3-way comparison
Inherited permissions from parent roles or SSO group membership — simulation must surface origin (local vs mapped)
Large groups (>10k users): simulation uses sampling and displays confidence intervals
External SSO sync will reapply group mappings after local edits — warn and link to SSO settings
metrics_and_success_criteria: Reduce post-release 'wrong permission assigned' incidents by 60% for roles covered by Composer
>70% of bulk-assign flows use snapshot undo within the first week of rollout
Average time to detect unauthorized role change decreases by 40% (measured via audit-lookup latency)
Admin satisfaction NPS for role management > 8 in pilot orgs
open_questions: Should simulate mode be available to all admins or gated behind a permission due to potential exposure of user lists?
What rate limits / cost visibility do we show for 'full scan' simulation that queries downstream services?
How should we represent unknown external resources (non-Console assets) in the impact list?
decisions: Prototype uses sampled simulation by default with 'Full scan' opt-in to protect runtime costs
Snapshot retention set to 30 days for standard plans; enterprise can request longer retention via Dedicated contract
SSO-mapped groups get a persistent warning badge and a tooltip linking to SSO sync settings
